problem_contract.desired: find a low-turnover FX-specific gross entry edge whose expected move can survive observed BID/ASK costs
problem_contract.as_is: V24 generated sufficient density but its reversal direction had negative proposal gross edge before costs
problem_contract.gap: a single pair boundary event did not distinguish a market-wide USD impulse from idiosyncratic pair noise
problem_contract.fact: V24 walk proposal mean gross return was -0.0001494045 across 259 signals
problem_contract.hypothesis: when at least five of seven liquid majors complete the Asian session with the same USD-oriented sign, aligned pairs carry that common currency impulse through the London morning
problem_contract.counter_hypothesis: Asian-session breadth is noise or reverses before London, and observable execution costs dominate
problem_contract.minimum_test: one fixed breadth threshold, one fixed London-morning horizon, identical signals in three cost arms, and effective bet days reported separately from tickets
problem_contract.stop_condition: reject if gross expectancy is nonpositive, any standalone development month loses after normal or adverse cost, or effective bet density is insufficient

single_changed_variable: replace pair-local sweep reversal with a cross-pair USD-oriented Asian-session coherence continuation signal

indicator.name: Asian USD Coherence Persistence
indicator.asian_measurement: for every pair, log(mid close at completed 05:55 UTC bar / mid open at 00:00 UTC bar)
indicator.usd_orientation: retain sign for USD_BASE pairs and invert sign for USD_QUOTE pairs
indicator.coherence_gate: at least five of the exact seven pairs have the same nonzero USD-oriented sign
indicator.eligible_pairs: only pairs whose own USD-oriented sign agrees with the majority; minority pairs remain cash
indicator.direction: continue the common USD impulse in each eligible pair's native quote convention
indicator.decision: after the completed 05:55 UTC M5 bar
indicator.exit: completed close of the 11:55 UTC M5 bar, corresponding to 12:00 UTC

evaluation.signal_identity: the exact same signal_id, entry, direction, and exit are used by all arms
evaluation.inventory: at most one position per pair and one coherent USD basket per UTC day; no add, martingale, or overlap
evaluation.allocation: each eligible pair receives its fixed 1/7 sleeve; unused sleeves remain cash; gross cap 1.0
evaluation.independence: effective bet count is the number of coherent UTC days, not the number of pair tickets

development_admission: at least 20 source signals in the full walk and each standalone month
at least 10 coherent UTC days in the full walk and at least 3 in each standalone month
proposal-level mean gross return is strictly positive in the full walk and each standalone month
normal and adverse equity multiples exceed 1.0 in the full walk and each standalone month
multiplicity: Count V25 as the first hypothesis in the FX session-currency coherence family.
